title: 2-D IFFT
text: 计算二维快速傅里叶逆变换 (IFFT)，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {FFT implementation} 指定FFT implementation；{Input is in bit-reversed order} 指定 Bit-reversed input、{Input is conjugate symmetric} 指定共轭对称输入、{Divide output by product of FFT length in each input dimension} 指定 Scale output data、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 指定数据类型覆盖，按实例取值。

params.name: Input is conjugate symmetric
params.values: 共轭对称输入 on (default) | off

params.name: Divide output by product of FFT length in each input dimension
Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 数据类型覆盖 off (default) | on
